1.name: Jock Landale
1.comment: Landale (hip) won't play Sunday against the Pistons.

1.name: Asa Newell
1.comment: Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

1.name: CJ McCollum
1.comment: McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

1.name: Mouhamed Gueye
1.comment: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

1.name: Henri Veesaar
1.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

2.name: Mitchell Robinson
2.comment: Robinson (illness) is out for Tuesday's game against Washington, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.

3.name: Julian Reese
3.comment: The Pelicans transferred Reese from the G League's Laketown Squadron, and he will be available for New Orleans' game against the Warriors on Monday.

3.name: Trendon Watford
3.comment: Watford (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.

3.name: Bennedict Mathurin
3.comment: Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.

3.name: Dejounte Murray
3.comment: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

4.name: Jalen Smith
4.comment: Smith (illness) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Charlotte.

4.name: Norman Powell
4.comment: Powell has been diagnosed with a mild right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated later this week.

4.name: Caleb Wilson
4.comment: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

5.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
5.comment: Tomlin (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.

5.name: Evan Mobley
5.comment: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.

6.name: Tobi Lawal
6.comment: Lawal (groin) is out for Tuesday's game against Denver.

6.name: Dereck Lively II
6.comment: Head coach Dusty May said Friday that Lively (foot) is moving well and progressing in his recovery, and the big man told May he's "close" to returning, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

6.name: Sergio de Larrea
6.comment: De Larrea (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

6.name: Tarik Biberovic
6.comment: Biberovic (heel) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

8.name: Cade Cunningham
8.comment: Cunningham (knee) is listed as out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.

8.name: Ebuka Okorie
8.comment: The Pistons announced Tuesday that Okorie (oblique) will miss at least two weeks, per Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com.

8.name: Taurean Prince
8.comment: Prince underwent arthroscopic right knee surgery Nov. 18 and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

8.name: Duncan Robinson
8.comment: Robinson (quadriceps) is considered day-to-day as he progresses in his rehab, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

8.name: Jalen Duren
8.comment: Duren (hamstring) is being assigned to the Motor City Cruise on Wednesday for practice as he ramps up for a return, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

9.name: Stephen Curry
9.comment: Curry (abdomen) will be re-evaluated Friday after Thanksgiving, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

9.name: Kristaps Porzingis
9.comment: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

9.name: Moses Moody
9.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

9.name: Jimmy Butler III
9.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

11.name: T.J. McConnell
11.comment: McConnell (hamstring) was recalled from the G League's Noblesville Boom on Tuesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

11.name: Tyrese Haliburton
11.comment: Haliburton (hamstring) was recalled from the G League's Noblesville Boom on Tuesday, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

11.name: Aaron Nesmith
11.comment: Nesmith is out for Monday's game against the Thunder due to right foot soreness.

11.name: Larry Nance Jr.
11.comment: Nance exited Monday's game against the Thunder due to a sore right ankle and he will not return, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

11.name: Ben Sheppard
11.comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

12.name: Bradley Beal
12.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

12.name: Jordan Miller
12.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

13.name: Austin Reaves
13.comment: Reaves (heel) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com reports.

16.name: LaMelo Ball
16.comment: Ball (ankle) did not return to Wednesday's 113-106 win over the Thunder.

16.name: Donte DiVincenzo
16.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) has been cleared for team basketball activities and is targeting a return to game action in January, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

16.name: Jaylen Clark
16.comment: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

16.name: Anthony Edwards
16.comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

17.name: Moritz Wagner
17.comment: Wagner (knee) will not return to Wednesday's game against the Bucks, C.J. Holmes of the New York Daily News reports.

17.name: Nolan Traore
17.comment: Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

18.name: Miles McBride
18.comment: McBride (adductor) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

18.name: Andre Drummond
18.comment: Drummond (head) did not return to Wednesday's 121-102 win over the Cavaliers.

18.name: OG Anunoby
18.comment: Anunoby (calf) participated in on-court work for the first time since sustaining the injury, Ian Begley of SportsNet New York reports.

18.name: Jordan Clarkson
18.comment: Clarkson (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.

19.name: Jonathan Isaac
19.comment: Isaac (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.

19.name: Izaiyah Nelson
19.comment: Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

19.name: Noah Penda
19.comment: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

19.name: Paolo Banchero
19.comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

20.name: Joel Embiid
20.comment: Embiid (illness) is out for Wednesday's game against Miami, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

20.name: Jaylen Brown
20.comment: Brown (hamstring) will receive imaging, and the Sixers will provide an update Thursday, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

20.name: Ariel Hukporti
20.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

21.name: Mark Williams
21.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

22.name: Chris Youngblood
22.comment: Youngblood (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

22.name: Vit Krejci
22.comment: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

22.name: Ja Morant
22.comment: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

22.name: Shaedon Sharpe
22.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

23.name: Zach LaVine
23.comment: LaVine (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus the Warriors.

23.name: Maxime Raynaud
23.comment: Raynaud (knee) was recalled from the G League's Stockton Kings on Wednesday, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.

23.name: Ben Simmons
23.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

24.name: De'Aaron Fox
24.comment: Fox (shin) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Portland, Jeff McDonald of the San Antonio Express-News reports.

24.name: Dylan Harper
24.comment: Harper (hip) is expected to miss two to three weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

24.name: Tobias Harris
24.comment: Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.

24.name: Jayden Quaintance
24.comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

25.name: Nikola Topic
25.comment: Topic (hip) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus Minnesota.

25.name: Jaylin Williams
25.comment: Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.

25.name: Aday Mara
25.comment: Mara (leg) is out for Wednesday's game versus the Timberwolves.

25.name: Jalen Williams
25.comment: Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.

25.name: Thomas Sorber
25.comment: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.

25.name: Cason Wallace
25.comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

25.name: Chet Holmgren
25.comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

26.name: Jaxson Hayes
26.comment: Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Lakers.

26.name: Jusuf Nurkic
26.comment: Nurkic (foot) has been cleared for on-court work and will be re-evaluated in one week.

26.name: Lauri Markkanen
26.comment: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

26.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
26.comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

27.name: Tristan Vukcevic
27.comment: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Boston.

27.name: Reece Beekman
27.comment: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

27.name: Justin Champagnie
27.comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

27.name: Jamir Watkins
27.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

28.name: Kawhi Leonard
28.comment: Leonard has begun individual on-court workouts following treatment to address swelling in his left knee, and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.

28.name: Nate Bittle
28.comment: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bucks, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

28.name: RJ Barrett
28.comment: Barrett has been diagnosed with a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

29.name: Zach Edey
29.comment: Edey (ankle) did not return to Wednesday's 115-97 win over the Clippers. He finished with seven points (3-4 FG, 1-1 FT), four rebounds, two assists and two blocks across nine minutes.

29.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
29.comment: Pippen (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

29.name: Cameron Boozer
29.comment: Boozer (ankle) will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

29.name: Jerami Grant
29.comment: Grant was diagnosed with a grade 1 left calf strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.

29.name: GG Jackson
29.comment: Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.

29.name: Richie Saunders
29.comment: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

30.name: Ryan Kalkbrenner
30.comment: Kalkbrenner (hip) has been ruled out for Wednesday's matchup with Chicago.

30.name: Grayson Allen
30.comment: Allen (concussion) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Chicago.

30.name: Dennis Schroder
30.comment: Schroder (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game the Bulls.

30.name: Kon Knueppel
30.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
